Threat Description: Attacker uses stolen employee credentials to impersonate an authorized user.
Risk Rationale: Credential theft is plausible in a retail environment (L4); unauthorized staff access could seriously affect internal systems (I4).

Threat Description: A rogue device impersonates a trusted POS terminal.
Risk Rationale: Rogue POS impersonation requires device or network access (L3); fraudulent transactions could cause major losses (I4).

Threat Description: Attacker forges a trusted service identity to access application APIs.
Risk Rationale: Forging a trusted service identity requires a suitable attack path (L3); compromise of critical APIs could have severe consequences (I5).

Threat Description: Unauthorized user modifies stock quantities or supplier records.
Risk Rationale: Unauthorized inventory changes are plausible where multiple staff and systems interact (L4); stock and financial integrity could be seriously affected (I4).

Threat Description: Malware alters sales transactions before processing.
Risk Rationale: POS transaction manipulation requires compromise of the transaction process (L3); widespread fraudulent sales could have severe consequences (I5).

Threat Description: Attacker modifies product prices or checkout parameters.
Risk Rationale: Web price manipulation is plausible without effective server-side validation (L4); the assumed financial impact is moderate (I3).

Threat Description: Employee disputes performing a POS refund due to insufficient audit records.
Risk Rationale: Missing transaction attribution could allow disputed refunds (L3); investigation and accountability impacts are moderate (I3).

Threat Description: Administrator denies making a configuration change.
Risk Rationale: Insufficient privileged logging could permit disputed configuration changes (L3); recovery and accountability impacts could be major (I4).

Threat Description: Staff member denies changing product stock records.
Risk Rationale: Weak change histories could permit disputed inventory adjustments (L3); operational and audit impacts are moderate (I3).
Customer database exposure is plausible without verified access controls (L4); widespread privacy harm could be severe (I5).

Threat Description: Payment tokens or transaction metadata leak through application logs.
Risk Rationale: Payment token or metadata leakage requires an insecure logging or integration path (L3); potential payment-related consequences could be severe (I5).

Threat Description: Unauthorized party accesses unencrypted or exposed backup copies.
Risk Rationale: Backup exposure requires unauthorized access or misconfiguration (L3); consolidated sensitive records could produce severe impact (I5).

Threat Description: High-volume malicious traffic overwhelms the online storefront.
Risk Rationale: Internet-facing storefronts are exposed to disruptive traffic (L4); prolonged downtime could seriously affect sales (I4).

Threat Description: Firewall resource exhaustion interrupts network connectivity.
Risk Rationale: Firewall exhaustion requires substantial load or an exploitable weakness (L3); interruption of multiple network services could be major (I4).

Threat Description: Malware or excessive requests make inventory services unavailable.
Risk Rationale: Inventory service disruption is plausible through malware or excessive requests (L4); stock-processing delays are assumed moderate (I3).

Threat Description: Compromised workstation gains elevated access to internal applications.
Risk Rationale: Employee endpoint compromise and privilege escalation are plausible (L4); elevated access could enable serious lateral movement (I4).

Threat Description: Application authorization flaw lets a standard user access admin functions.
Risk Rationale: Application authorization flaws are plausible without verified enforcement (L4); unauthorized administrative functions could have severe impact (I5).

Threat Description: Weak management controls allow unauthorized switch administration.
Risk Rationale: Switch management compromise requires access to the management plane (L3); network changes or interception could have major impact (I4).
